preconditions.description: The number of employees n must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of events m must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 3 for t in event_types)
preconditions.description: Each event type t must be 1, 2, or 3.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in employees)
preconditions.description: All employee numbers x must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= packet_count for i in packet_indices)
preconditions.description: All packet indices i must be valid and within the range of existing packets.

postconditions.description: For each query of type 3, output 'YES' if the employee signed the document, otherwise 'NO'.
The number of outputs must match the number of type 3 queries.

invariants.description: The company structure must not have cyclic dependencies at any point.

invariants.expression: all(boss[x] is None or boss[x] != x for x in range(1, n + 1))
invariants.description: No employee can be their own boss.
